summary: Aethlon Medical filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose that, following recent exercises of pre-funded warrants, all previously outstanding pre-funded warrants had been exercised, leaving 1,604,095 common shares outstanding as of August 28, 2026. The filing is a routine transactional update regarding warrant exercises; it does not announce a merger, tender offer, strategic review, or any other special situation. The issuer simply reported the completion of warrant exercises and the resulting share count. No deal terms, advisors, or recommendations are provided. This is an informational current report with no special-situation implications; what to watch is potential dilution impact, but no event requiring classification is present.
